routes.finished_subroute_identity: Only as FSSR 2.4.6(18) standardized cleaned, de-saponified Chenopodium quinoa grain, unblended and sold as quinoa grain; not processed quinoa flour, a composite breakfast cereal or a quinoa ingredient inside unrelated recipes.
routes.named_qualified_finished_article: Cereal and cereal products — limited to aflatoxin crop-contaminant assessment of qualifying standardized quinoa grain
routes.primary_official_evidence: FSSR Chapter 2.4, 2.4.6(18) standardizes Quinoa as a dried matured grain; CTR IX §2.2.1 uses 'Cereal and cereal products' for total aflatoxins and aflatoxin B1 (PDF page 14), without the explicit quinoa exclusion found in §2.1.1 cereal-grain metal rows.

source_article_candidates.analytical_basis: finished standardized quinoa grain; conditional class determination; analytical identity and latest amendments to be checked
finished standardized quinoa grain; conditional class determination; analytical identity and latest amendments to be checked

positive_source_basis: FSSR Chapter 2.4 explicitly places standardized quinoa grain in Cereals and Cereal Products, clause 2.4.6(18).
CTR IX §2.2.1 has separate named Cereal and cereal products total aflatoxins and aflatoxin B1 articles.
CTR's grain-metal quinoa exclusions do not appear in those named crop-contaminant entries; exceptions remain analyte-specific.
This source route is conditional on marketed finished form actually being the standardized unblended quinoa grain.
Do not infer that raw ingredient test data, processing factors or a processed quinoa recipe are equivalent to this finished article.
negative_transfer_controls: Never inherit the CTR lead or cadmium 'cereal grains except ... quinoa' article.
Do not borrow 2,4-D MRL for 'milled food grains' for quinoa without independent residue proof.
Do not classify chia seed as cereal just because it is in the same FSSR chapter.
Do not classify quinoa composite foods as unblended quinoa grain.
Do not infer passing aflatoxin results, laboratory sampling, or total regulatory clearance.
Aflatoxin category interpretation for an actual marketed product requires regulator-reviewed current applicability evidence.

routes.finished_subroute_identity: Only plain, washed/blanched and frozen vegetable portions retaining vegetable identity; separate classification required for curried/seasoned mixtures, sauces, milk-solids additions, composite ready-to-eat dishes and species-specific lead/cadmium categories.
routes.named_qualified_finished_article: Vegetables — only conditionally for plain frozen vegetables retaining the vegetable matrix and not the separate named processed/mixture class
routes.primary_official_evidence: FSSR 2.3.38 defines washed, blanched and frozen vegetables as the product, including individually quick-frozen portions; CTR IX §2.1.1 lists named broad 'Vegetables' articles for Cu, As, Cr, Ni and Sb, while some other metals have subtype-specific and processed-food rows.

positive_source_basis: FSSR Chapter 2.3 standard 2.3.38 expressly calls washed, blanched and frozen vegetables a finished marketed product.
CTR IX §2.1.1, Copper 'Vegetables' appears on PDF page 8 at 30 mg/kg.
CTR IX §2.1.1, Arsenic 'Vegetables' appears on PDF page 10 at 1.1 mg/kg.
CTR IX §2.1.1, Chromium, Nickel and Antimony 'Vegetables' appear on PDF page 13 at 1 mg/kg each.
The conditional subroute applies only if actual final product is plain vegetable portions rather than a mixed/seasoned finished preparation.
negative_transfer_controls: Do not transfer the lead or cadmium raw vegetable subtype without identifying exact vegetable species and legal form.
Do not inherit unrelated canned vegetables, vegetables puree or processed tomato concentrate entries.
Do not apply a plain vegetable entry to salted, spiced, dairy-containing, curried or mixed composite meals without category proof.
Do not use plant-ingredient limits as finished composite food limits.
Do not auto-convert any regulatory numerical value into a lab acceptance PASS.
Actual product species, processing, marketed form and sampling basis remain unverified.
